title: La catedral
goal: Get the story of the cathedral out of somebody who wants paying for it
culture: He sells the tower climb, but the history he tells for free, because telling it is the part he likes. Saying you have no money on you today is not a refusal here — it is a fact about today, and it leaves him his dignity and you the story.

beats.es: ¿Tour de la catedral, amigo? Cinco dólares y subimos a la torre.
beats.objective: Say you have no money on you
beats.en: I haven’t got any money on me.
beats.good: No ando con... is what you have not got on you right now, which is softer than no tengo. It closes nothing.

beats.es: Ah, qué lástima. Y yo me sé toda la historia, desde que la quemaron.
beats.objective: Ask him to tell it anyway
beats.good: ¿Me cuenta? asks for the story and not the tour, so there is nothing for him to charge for and no reason to say no.

beats.es: Pues mire: la quemaron los filibusteros y la levantaron tres veces. Esa torre es del quince.
beats.objective: Thank him for something he gave you free
beats.en: Very kind of you. Thank you.
beats.good: Muy amable pays for a favour that had no price on it. It is the nearest thing to a tip you can hand over in words.

beats.es: Y para la torre aquí ando todos los días, desde temprano.
beats.objective: Leave the tower for another day
beats.good: Otro día is a real later, not a polite no. It keeps him friendly and keeps the tower on offer.
